svg.title: How Printora prints from your phone
svg.desc: A document is scanned on an Android phone and sent over Wi-Fi, or sent from a browser through a Cloudflare tunnel. The Windows server approves the device, decrypts in memory, queues the job, prints it, and shreds the temporary file.

g.text: Local Wi-Fi Mode: Instant phone-to-printer fast path with zero cloud storage
Remote & Web Print: Private Cloudflare Tunnel Relay with PIN verification
Temporary files shredded on job end

svg.text: All jobs & configs remain strictly on this PC
Local-First • No Telemetry • No Cloud Storage
Document scanner & local Wi-Fi fast path
Scan QR from PC • No app installation needed

g.text: Discovering Windows PC on local Wi-Fi
Scanning QR code from Windows PC
